## Everything you need to communicate

Three pillars powering accessible, barrier-free communication for everyone.

## Real-Time Sign Recognition

Our vision AI models interpret hand gestures and sign language in real-time with sub-80ms latency, enabling natural, fluid communication without delay.

- Supports 200+ ASL and BSL signs with 97.4% accuracy

- Works in low-light and cluttered backgrounds

- Continuous learning from anonymized user interactions

- Live overlay with translated text and voice output

## Military-Grade Protection

Every frame, every sign, every communication is encrypted end-to-end. Your health and communication data is yours alone — never sold, never shared.

- AES-256 encryption for all video streams

- TLS 1.3 in transit, at-rest encryption

- HIPAA and GDPR compliant architecture

- Zero-knowledge proof identity verification

## Life-Critical Communication

When seconds matter, Uvilox AI enables deaf and hard-of-hearing users to connect with emergency services through real-time sign-to-voice translation.

- Direct 911 and emergency dispatch integration

- Automatic location sharing in emergency mode

- Real-time captions for both parties on the call

- One-tap SOS with pre-loaded profile data
